item.title: Australian judge rejects prisoner's human rights challenge to Vegemite ban
item.description: Andre McKechnie, 55, is serving a life sentence for murder. He challenged the ban on the salty, sticky byproduct of brewing beer in court.

item.title: Judge rules DOJ illegally fired daughter of former FBI director Comey
item.description: Maurene Comey served as a federal prosecutor in Manhattan for about a decade. The ruling adds to concerns over political interference.

item.title: Trump administration seeks food assistance card upgrade to combat fraud
item.description: The proposed rule aims to address fraud that has cost SNAP recipients millions.

item.title: China's plenum: What to know as Xi pushes for stronger party discipline
item.description: The closed-door meeting began Monday, roughly a year before Xi is expected to secure a fourth term and make changes to key leadership posts.
